text:
Priya (Content): Heads-up — we need 6x 15–30s microclips from the 'Serving at scale' webinar for X and LinkedIn. Priorities: 3 product-forward, 2 benchmark highlights, 1 customer soundbite. Can design + video pick these up by EOD Wed? Loom of full recording: https://loom.example/serving-at-scale. Need captions/CTAs + suggested thumbnails.

Jon (Design): Can do 3 thumbnails + 6 short captions. Will need exact timestamps for clips. Pinged video team.

Liam (Growth): Routing + timing thoughts: X promo goes Tues 10am PT; LinkedIn Tues 1pm PT. We'll run A/B caption tests on X. Seedlist should include CSMs, top customers, and a small press list — confirm embargo.

Riley (Ops): I can route to seedlist. Send final captions by Mon noon or I won't hit the routing windows. Also confirm aspect ratios for LI carousel exports.

Kai (Social): For X, do we want 9:16 native or 1:1? Recommend exporting both: 9:16 for short-first, 1:1 for feed. Also need SRT captions and a one-line CTA per clip.

Priya (Content): Timestamps added to the shared sheet: https://docs.example/webinar-microclips (please check). Quick list: product demos 00:05:12–00:05:35, 00:21:10–00:21:35; benchmark highlights 00:12:00–00:12:25 and 00:33:40–00:33:55; customer soundbite 00:45:20–00:45:45.

Jon (Design): Got the sheet. Will upload rough thumbnails + caption variants to Drive `marketing/webinar-microclips/3355551234/` by EOD tomorrow.

Liam (Growth): Seedlist note: exclude embargoed press and the analyst list unless Priya confirms. Also planning a small paid boost for whichever X clip wins the A/B within 24h.

Riley (Ops): Routing rules proposal: Group A = internal + beta customers; Group B = public social. I'll create calendar handoff for Wed 2pm PT. If captions land by Mon noon I can schedule automation.

Kai (Social): Quick CTA drafts: 
- Short: "See how we cut gen-cost by 3x — watch the clip"
- Link CTA: "Full talk in bio"
Short captions for X, longer for LinkedIn with a short TL;DR.

Priya (Content): Owners recap: Jon = thumbnails, video-team = clip edits, Kai = captions & posting, Riley = seed routing. CCing video-bot. If anyone can't meet EOD Wed, flag now. :sparkles:

video-bot: New task created: MV-2143 - microclip edits assigned to @video-team. ETA Wed 6pm PT.

Sam (Design): Small ask — can we get clean 1080p B-roll frames exported for LI carousel slides? If not, I'll pull stills from the recording.

Priya (Content): Yes — video team will export 1080p stills and SRTs. I've added a checklist column in the sheet. Thanks all :pray:

Jon (Design): FYI schedule snippet — exporting these formats: ```
- X: 9:16 (vertical) + 1:1 (square)
- LinkedIn: 1:1 + 16:9 for long post
- Files: mp4 H.264, 1080p, SRT captions attached
```

Liam (Growth): Perfect. Once roughs are in Drive I'll queue A/B pairs and share seedlist spreadsheet for review.

Riley (Ops): I'll set the routing automation after captions final. Calendar invites sent.

Priya (Content): Thanks team — will follow up Monday with any caption tweaks. If any blocker ping me directly. :)
